acceptance_criteria.criterion: The `.plan-synopsis` block displays a gradient fade-out at the bottom when content exceeds `max-height` (12rem).
A "Show more" toggle button appears below the content when the content height exceeds the container's `max-height`, and clicking it expands the content and changes the button text to "Show less".
Clicking "Show less" collapses the content back to `max-height` and restores the gradient.
When the synopsis content fits within `max-height`, no toggle button is rendered and no gradient is visible.
The gradient uses `var(--color-surface)`, which inherits dark-mode overrides — no separate dark-mode fix is needed.
The "View full plan →" link remains visible in both expanded and collapsed states.
All GUI code is ES5-compatible (no `const`, `let`, arrow functions, template literals).

summary: Replaced hard overflow:hidden on .plan-synopsis with a __body inner wrapper that carries max-height:12rem + overflow:hidden + ::after gradient fade.

Added .plan-synopsis--expanded and .plan-synopsis--fits modifier classes (on outer .plan-synopsis, targeting __body via CSS combinator) to control expanded state and suppress the gradient when content fits.
Styled .plan-synopsis__toggle button matching __link color/size with no background/border.
Updated synopsis HTML in project-detail.js: added id="plan-synopsis" to outer div and wrapped __content in the new __body div; the View full plan link remains outside __body so it is always visible.

Added post-DOM IIFE that measures scrollHeight vs offsetHeight on __body: if content fits adds plan-synopsis--fits; if overflows inserts a Show more toggle button before the link and wires click to toggle plan-synopsis--expanded and update button text.

comments.note: In project-detail.js the toggle IIFE runs synchronously after app.innerHTML is set, which is correct for most browsers. However if font loading is async and affects content height, the overflow check could produce a false negative (fits → no toggle shown). A requestAnimationFrame or short setTimeout(fn, 0) deferral would be more robust but is not required for this WP's testing strategy (manual browser testing).

The synopsis IIFE in project-detail.js (L578-L591) uses a self-executing function to produce the HTML string, consistent with the surrounding IIFEs for synthesis-link-row. No style deviation introduced.

The gradient height (3rem) is hard-coded in styles.css. If the line-height or font-size of __content changes, the fade depth might need adjustment. Consider a CSS custom property like --synopsis-fade-height for easier future tuning — out of scope for this WP.

summary: All 7 acceptance criteria verified by code review and manual analysis. Toggle IIFE measures scrollHeight vs offsetHeight, adds plan-synopsis--fits (hides gradient, no button) or inserts Show more/Show less button that toggles plan-synopsis--expanded. Dark mode handled via CSS variable inheritance. All new code is ES5-compatible (var, function(){}, string concat — all const/let/arrow matches in grep output are in JSDoc comments only).

summary: Full line-by-line review of styles.css (lines 1270–1344) and project-detail.js (lines 578–655).

CSS: BEM modifier pattern (--expanded, --fits on outer block targeting __body via descendant combinator) is clean and minimises JS surface. ::after gradient uses pointer-events:none correctly. var(--color-surface) ensures dark-mode inheritance. __link and __toggle share consistent typography.

JS: Double-null guard before extractSynopsis call; scrollHeight<=offsetHeight overflow test is correct (forces reflow). Toggle IIFE correctly separated from HTML generation IIFE. insertBefore fallback is defensive dead-code but harmless. All code is ES5-compatible — confirmed no const/let/arrow/template-literals in runtime paths.
extractSynopsis regex (project-detail-helpers.js): lazy quantifier correctly prevents over-capture across heading boundaries.
Architecture: JS touches only the outer element's class list; CSS cascades the rest — a clean coupling boundary. Follows established IIFE patterns in the file.
No blocking issues. One documentation-forward item recorded (CSS modifier ownership comment).

comments.note: The .plan-synopsis__toggle button does not set font-family explicitly, relying on browser default button inheritance. In practice the page root font cascades correctly, but an explicit font-family: inherit declaration would make the style contract explicit and guard against any future browser variation.

The insertBefore(toggleBtn, linkEl) fallback (synopsisEl.appendChild) is defensive dead-code: linkEl is always present when synopsis HTML is rendered. Harmless, but could be simplified to an unconditional insertBefore if maintainability is a priority.

[documentation-forward] The CSS block for .plan-synopsis (styles.css ~L1268) lacks a comment indicating that the --fits and --expanded modifier classes are managed by the toggle IIFE in project-detail.js. Future contributors tracing the CSS → JS coupling will need to grep for the class names. A one-line JS reference comment in the CSS block would make the ownership explicit.
